admission.goal: A non-empty PHP mbstring regex pattern is accepted by `mb_ereg`/`mb_eregi` and handed to Oniguruma for compilation as the internal regex object.
admission.predicate: parse.hit && compile.hit && parse.arg_pattern_len > 0 && parse.arg_pattern == compile.pattern && parse.arg_pattern_len == compile.patlen

root.goal: Compilation reaches a quantified subexpression whose body is non-null and has zero minimum byte length, so `tune_quant` will classify its emptiness by traversing the body node graph.

target.goal: The same quantified body node is later dereferenced inside `quantifiers_memory_node_info`, matching the issue's heap-use-after-free read during emptiness analysis.
